verdict.rationale: Metronome supports real-time-ish ingestion and an event explorer for internal usage visibility (metronome-docs-2, metronome-docs-12), webhooks firing when a 'threshold is reached' (metronome-docs-4), and a customizable in-product billing dashboard for customers (metronome-docs-11). However, thresholds/alerts are delivered only as raw webhook events requiring the customer to build their own notification/UI layer, not a built-in alerting or dashboard-with-thresholds feature out of the box. Missing for 10: evidence of a native alert/notification UI or email/Slack alerting on thresholds, and evidence of a real-time (not just periodic) ops-facing cost dashboard.
